triggers: audit whether this github release is complete
verify the remote evidence for a published release

rationale: Compared internal github-release-evidence:audit-github-release with openai:gh-fix-ci, openai:gh-address-comments, and the pending official GitHub PR-check evidence. Pre-release review found that revision 1 proved the PR was merged and the tag matched the Release target, but did not prove that the PR merge commit was the tagged commit; it also rendered untrusted snapshot newlines without flattening them. These are concrete correctness and report-integrity gaps in the same capability, so update is preferable to merge, discard, or a duplicate creation. Verification adds failing mismatch/injection tests, raises the end-to-end matrix to eight gates, and reruns official format validators.
